pillar.description: Short lowercase code. Must match the file name, and prefixes every system id.

external.description: Every system here is reached by outside callers, unless it says otherwise.

id.description: pillar.system, lowercase kebab-case, unique in the town.

service.description: Systems that share a service are drawn side by side on one pad (an API, its worker and its database).

external.description: Reached by callers outside the town.

calls.description: Systems this one calls directly. Cars drive only along these links.

gatewayCalls.description: Systems on other islands this one reaches through the API gateway. They draw the dependency overlay and decide where the cars come from.

aliases.description: Former ids of this system, so files that still use them keep working after a rename.
